authority: Production host-side connector and electrical map for the board's generic 15-pin Raspberry-Pi-style MIPI DSI interface.
selection_basis: The mainboard requires a standard 15-way 1.0 mm Raspberry-Pi-style MIPI DSI host interface.
Raspberry Pi Compute Module Camera/Display Adapter reference BOM uses SFW15R-2STE1LF for this top-contact interface.
DSI506/DYL0023 is one physically accepted compatibility profile; other models require their own electrical, power, firmware and cable qualification.
